alt: An animated presentation drawn live in code, with no people in it. A title card reads Signed: this website, told from its own history, sovereignwebsite.ai. 861 coloured boxes, one per file of the website, pack into a block, then sort into stacks by kind. 61 glowing beads on a timeline stand for the site's changes, and threads of light join each one to the key of the agent that signed it. A current of light flows around five glowing rings, each holding a rule the site's agents must keep. A plain white slide asks: Who holds the keys? You do. Credits list who made it and the sources of every fact.
